notes: 2.2.6 The incidence of Accidental Deaths decreased by 1.1 per cent at national level during 1996 as
compared to the previous year. However, it is observed from Table-3(A) that 16 States & UTs reported
increases in the incidence of Accidental Deaths. The highest increase was reported from Arunachal
Pradesh (100%) followed by Andhra Pradesh (39.9%). The remaining equal number of States & Uts
reported decreases as compared to the previous year.
Source for col. 2:- Registrar General of India
2.3.1 The ‘Accidental Deaths’ due to Natural Causes and those due to Un-natural Causes were observed
to be in the proportion of 8.6% and 91.4%. The magnitude of ‘Accidental Deaths’ by Natural Causes
decreased from 21600 to 18930 (-12.4%) and that of deaths by Un-natural Causes increased marginally
